member.name: T:Text.Str
member.summary: Provides static utility methods for string analysis and manipulation.
member.remarks: The Str class contains static methods for performing common string operations. All methods are static and can be called without creating an instance of the class.

member.name: M:Text.Str.IsPalindrome(System.String)
member.summary: Determines whether the given string is a palindrome.
member.remarks: A palindrome is a sequence of characters that reads the same forward and backward. This method ignores letter case, spaces, and non-alphanumeric characters when performing the comparison. A null string or a string that becomes empty after filtering is considered a palindrome.
member.param: The input string to evaluate. Non-alphanumeric characters and case are ignored.
member.returns: true if the cleaned string is a palindrome; false otherwise.
